      read gives NOT-RUN. A3* = UNLICENSED in both cases.
    REASONING:
      The exclusivity gap closes. A locked f2 that never launches has no terminal event other than a
      PI stop. That residue was already carried as minor at STOP-8 C122 and fails conservatively.
  REFUTER [strict] resolves=True overturned=False severity=clean
    EVIDENCE:
      Partition over f2's real outcomes. No session of any arm reaches a first read → NOT-RUN only.
      Uninstructed arm with no domain session but at least one session reaching a first read → not
      NOT-RUN, so NO-READ by §5's arm rule, even where the control read nothing (the 'while another
      arm read' gloss is descriptive). Both arms with domain sessions → a coordinate value with the
      control state. A cap or PI stop with no first read → NOT-RUN 'as m's units' (m:324). A3* is
